forecast_notes.rationale: Company-specific demo scenario rates and market sensitivities are authored assumptions, not analyst consensus or issuer guidance. Forecast EPS is projected on the issuer fiscal-year labels using the original calendar-month interpolation approximation.
forecast_notes.calendar_approximation: Issuer fiscal-year labels feed the original calendar-month EPS interpolation; this is a scenario approximation, not a quarterly financial model.
